summary: Title Update 5 shipped Oct 1 as versions 1.013 and 1.014: Ballhawk now strafes, QB slides near the first-down line no longer super dive, QB-sneak audibles no longer auto pinch or spread the defensive line, and interceptions carried into the end zone are no longer safeties. TU5 has no coverage, blitz, route, blocking, or pass-rush tuning, and no 1.015 was found as of Oct 6, so the Sept 22 (1.012 / TU 4.5) spin and contain changes and the Sept 3 (1.010) man-coverage changes still stand. Bunch remains the consensus passing meta (Washington State Gun Bunch X Nasty, Ohio State, Charlotte) and 4-2-5 / 4-2-5 Man Pressure remain the top defensive books. Match quarters (Box check vs bunch) and Cover 6 are the standard answers to bunch crossers and verticals; underneath-first passing beats two-high.

patch.title: Title Update 5 - October 1, 2026 (1.013 and 1.014)
notes: Added functionality to allow users to strafe while in Ballhawk.
Fixed an issue where the QB would super dive when attempting to slide near the first down line.
Fixed an issue where the Defensive Line would auto pinch or spread when audibling in or out of QB sneak.
Fixed an issue where Interceptions caught near and carried into the endzone would be ruled a Safety.

findings.claim: Title Update 5 (posted Sept 30 for an Oct 1 release) adds strafing while in Ballhawk, and fixes QB super dives on slides near the first-down line, the defensive line auto pinching or spreading when audibling in or out of QB sneak, and interceptions caught near and carried into the end zone being ruled a safety. The gameplay list has no coverage, blitz, route, blocking, or pass-rush tuning; other TU5 changes are Dynasty coach goals and coach points, Road to Glory practice freezes, Ultimate Team EVO fixes, an Online H2H uniform fix, new uniforms, and PS5 crowd audio.
Oct 1 Title Update 5 shipped as two back-to-back downloads, version 1.013 and then 1.014 about an hour or two later, with one consolidated note set.

Insider Gaming's patch history labels the Oct 1 notes as Title Update 5 (the latest update listed) and the prior gameplay notes — run-action blocking, custom-adjustment contains, reduced QB spin, WR catch tuning, and the field-goal block fix — as Title Update 4.5.

Oct 6 recheck: games.gg (updated Oct 1) still ranks Washington State Gun Bunch X Nasty as the most complete offensive book, lists Oregon State and Colorado as post-update alternatives, and keeps Auto Base Protection on Empty with Blocking on Balanced. 4-2-5 Man Pressure (3-3 Cub) and base 4-2-5 remain the top defensive books, with Dollar against spread.
Sept 22 update 1.012 reduced QB spin move effectiveness behind the line and fixed custom-adjustment contains not being respected.
Sept 3 update 1.010 targeted overly effective man coverage (pass lead, route running, jostle, man press penalty) and fixed Cloud Flats ignoring user drop depths and Combo converting to Lock in press.

Bunch is the CFB 27 passing meta: Washington State Gun Bunch X Nasty is the most complete offensive book (man and zone beaters, runs via Pistol Trips / Pistol U Off Trips), red zone from Singleback Deuce Close.
4-2-5 Man Pressure (3-3 Cub, Nickel, Dime, man blitzes mixed with zone) is the consensus number two defensive book behind base 4-2-5.
4-2-5 Even Cover 3 Sky with a slid line, linebacker blitz and QB contain on both sides is a popular saved blitz macro that gets home against slide protection.
Post-update settings: Auto Base Protection to Empty and Blocking to Balanced; aggressive blocking now draws holding and speed boosting is gone.
Cover 4 Quarters with the Box match check is the answer to bunch crossers and rubs; Cover 6 switches to Palms vs trips and Box vs bunch.
Mabel-style zone macro (cloud flats ~25 yds, slot curl flats 5 yds, hook curls) takes away sideline floods and corners, funneling throws to the user in the middle.
Beat Cover 4 underneath first (flats, drags, quick outs, curls, RB routes); only take posts and deep shots after the quarter safety or flat defender cheats.
Beat Cover 3 with flood concepts, flats, curls, crossers and seams thrown before the middle safety closes.
Beat blitz with quick slants, drags, mesh, Texas and RB outlets; use motion to confirm man.
A live content update reportedly lets CPU defenses adjust to repeated outside runs, so spamming stretch vs CPU is less reliable.

suggestions.label: Strafe in Ballhawk
suggestions.tip: Ballhawk now allows strafing, so a user-controlled defender can stay in the passing lane while ballhawking.

suggestions.label: Set the DL on QB sneak
suggestions.tip: Audibling in or out of QB sneak no longer auto pinches or spreads the defensive line — set the line shift yourself if you want a pinch or a spread.

suggestions.label: Slide at the sticks
suggestions.tip: Sliding near the first-down line no longer super dives, so a slide at the sticks is a normal slide again.

suggestions.label: Quarters Box vs bunch
suggestions.tip: Against Gun Bunch looks call Cover 4 Quarters with the Box match check and user the deep middle; it passes off Cross Wheels and mesh rubs.

suggestions.label: Contains work again
suggestions.tip: Since 1.012, contains set in custom adjustments are respected and QB spin moves are weaker — keep QB contain on vs scramblers instead of spying.

suggestions.label: Take it underneath vs two-high
suggestions.tip: Against Cover 4 / Cover 6, hit flats, drags and curls until a safety comes down, then go post or corner.

suggestions.label: Vary runs vs CPU
suggestions.tip: CPU defenses reportedly key on repeated outside runs now — alternate Inside Zone / outside zone instead of spamming stretch.

suggestions.label: Protection settings
suggestions.tip: Set Auto Base Protection to Empty and Blocking to Balanced; aggressive blocking now draws holding.
